scope: Independent source inspection and finite numerical controls of the current measured-subspace solver. This is not a complete-atmosphere root or a convergence guarantee.

test_execution.inspection: The reviewer parsed the existing test receipt and inspected the source; these six tests were executed by the implementation agent.

correspondence: At each iterate, every product Y[:,i]=(F(theta+h_i*S[:,i])-F(theta))/h_i is measured at the same current anchor using the complete residual.
Two modified Gram-Schmidt passes form orthonormal search directions selected from -P times the current least-squares remainder. P=I+L R is only a search accelerator.
The least-squares correction minimizes ||F+Y c||_2. P_new=P+(S-P Y) pinv(Y) matches the measured inverse action on the retained product range; it is not identified with an exact Jacobian inverse.
The proposed coordinate change is capped at 0.5, then backtracked. Only actual residual decrease and all domain/physical guards permit an accepted state.
A failed probe, insufficient measured direction, or rejected search retains the previous physical state and cannot produce a root claim.
The final export still requires blend one, complete infinity residual below 1e-9, fresh-repeat difference below 1e-10, all physical/conservation guards, and unchanged input/source hashes.
Nonfinite conservation errors are converted to JSON null only after all acceptance flags are computed from the raw errors. This reporting fix does not accept invalid states.
limitations: Forward differences, adaptive coordinate increments and at most 24 basis directions do not establish derivative accuracy or convergence of the 8840-dimensional atmosphere.
Singular product directions are discarded by pseudoinverse thresholds; the retained inverse can remain approximate outside the measured span.
L2 decrease during search is distinct from the infinity-norm root criterion. A partly reduced residual is not an equilibrium.
The earlier Broyden attempt was interrupted at its accepted checkpoint after non-descent trials. That numerical history does not falsify the changed physics.
